statement: Explicit separable closures of finite-variable rational function fields admit exact finite-stage arithmetic computable p-components effective finite-system decisions and all finite-tower factorization
notes: The fair separable splitting tower is constructive. Haran quantifier elimination is evaluated using explicit p-basis components computed by finite linear algebra; finite algebra equations are translated into coordinates. No existential oracle is assumed.

statement: Complete ordinary canonical free-generator split WG over finite commutative algebras and effective coherent local henselizations with finite separably closed residue extensions
notes: Division quotients are actual finite purely inseparable fields with trivial adjoint, not the ground field by assumption. Every self-dual indecomposable has exactly one sign. Orthogonal forms and symplectic or dual hyperbolics give literal free-Z generators and all operations.

statement: Separably closed fields of finite imperfection degree at least two and their finite algebras and affine local henselizations give new non-C1 coefficient families
notes: The explicit quasilinear p-form in p^r variables is anisotropic by p-basis independence. Transcendence degree at least two excludes global and henselian-global finite extensions, and positive characteristic excludes Q-algebras.
